name: blockui_dynamic_zh_cn
_说明: ⚠️ blockui 的 Alignment 枚举把「top left / top horizontal / vertical horizontal」这类串当**行为标志**用：构造器里 tag.contains("horizontal") 决定 horizontalCentered、contains("right") 决定 rightAligned。译成中文之后 contains 全部落空，**整个 blockui 的对齐系统失效**——所有界面的文字一律贴左，MineColonies / 建筑棒全中招。这 9 条已移除，永远不许再译。

But you might face situations under which looking through transparent preview will make the rendered result weird, wrong or even may enable you to see through other things.
